notes.title: Wholese Games Celebration Demo
notes.content:
Hello Flighters!
Our Pre-Alpha Demo is once again available for you all to play. Summer has been quite busy for us with lots going on but we have added some new little things that you might like such as:
- if you are capable of collecting enough stamps, buy the Spring Hook and the Zipline Hook, equip them on the inventory. Shoot 2 points in the world like the zipline, now jump on the cable and have fun ;)

Don't forget to wishlist and give feedback through our discord or form as this will help us tremendously to continuing to develop CTF. We are planning lots of new things for it's development so 

Northrak Team

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.4-a
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who has given our demo a shot! We understand the game is still a bit rough around the edges, we appreciate all support and patience while we make Close to Flight the best it can be!

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to jump off while Ziplining
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed some ground collision in the level
[*] Fixed small issues with the UIs
[*] Fixed the Zipline so it doesn't teleport you to the abyss
[*] Disabled the accessibility slowdown while placing the 2nd Zipline Anchor
[/list]

notes.title: Close to Flight Demo Available!
notes.content:
Hello Flighters!
With our participation on Women-Led Games in Summer Game Fest, we have made a Pre-Alpha Demo available for you all to play. Please wishlist and give feedback through our discord or form.

We hope you like this little taster as we have many things planned for the future. 

Northrak Team

notes.title: We are part of Tentacle Zone!
notes.content:
Hello there Snoop Birds,

We are happy to announce that Northrak got selected to participate in the accelerator programme [url=https://tentacle.zone/incubator/]Tentacle Zone[/url]. 

It has been a few weeks now but we have nothing but good things to say about this opportunity. the sheer amount of support we've been getting to not only improve Northrak but Close to Flight has been phenomenal! 

Keep an eye out for future updates as we will have more Close to Flight news coming up (like, really, really) soon!

Yours truly,
Northrak
